name: World Pulse
description: A no-politics briefing of science/health breakthroughs, major natural disasters, and high-impact economy news from the last day or two.
trigger: science / health / space breakthroughs + disasters briefing, no politics

inputs.name: focus
inputs.prompt: Any topic or region to prioritize? (optional)

steps.label: Sweep science, space & health
steps.instruction: Run 2-3 searches with varied queries for science, space, and health/medicine BREAKTHROUGHS from the last 24-48 hours using brave-search (its search parameter is `q`). Capture concrete facts, figures, and the source outlet for each.

steps.label: Sweep disasters & high-impact economy
steps.instruction: Run 2-3 more brave-search queries (param `q`) for major NATURAL DISASTERS and high-impact economy/business news from the last 24-48 hours. (Optionally serper for breadth.) Capture facts + sources.

steps.label: Filter & rank
steps.instruction: Combine all results. DROP anything political, opinion/analysis, or conflict/diplomacy. Keep only hard breakthroughs and high-impact items. De-dupe and rank by significance. Reason this out yourself — no service call.

steps.label: Write the briefing
steps.instruction: Write a clean 5-8 item briefing: a one-line headline + one sentence of context + the source outlet for each item, grouped (Science/Space, Health, Disasters, Economy). Plain markdown.
